item.title: Alexa+ lands in Australia to offer an AI-powered experience that is more powerful and more personal
item.summary: The Alexa personal assistant is already a part of daily life for millions of Australians and it has just got even smarter, more conversational and more capable with the launch of Alexa+. Alexa+ is a significant upgrade in personal AI that makes the experience deeper and more useful than simply answering questions and controlling smart [...] The post Alexa+ lands in Australia to offer an AI-powered experience that is more powerful and more personal appeared first on Tech Guide .
